summary: Backend and full-stack software engineer with experience building interactive web applications, data analytics platforms, and ETL/data pipeline systems. Skilled in Python, JavaScript, React, Node.js, and data science tooling, with strong interests in scalable architectures, algorithm visualization, and applied machine learning.

experience.title: Assistant System Engineer
bullets: Developed AWS Glue ETL pipelines using PySpark to migrate over 100,000 insurance claims from legacy mainframe extract files (TXT) into an Oracle-based target database.
Built transformation logic for a base dataset and 25 worker datasets, implementing data cleansing, validation, and business rule transformations before loading into target tables.
Developed and maintained modular Glue jobs, enabling scalable processing across multiple worker tables.
Configured deployment artifacts using YAML and HQL YAML definitions to support automated CI/CD deployments.
Integrated Glue jobs into Apache Airflow (AWS MWAA) DAGs for dependency management and sequential workflow orchestration.
Collaborated with teammates to validate migrated data and ensure consistency between source mainframe records and Oracle target tables.

projects.name: AlgoViz - Algorithm Visualizer
projects.description: Interactive web platform for visualizing sorting and pathfinding algorithms step-by-step with playback controls including play, pause, and step-through functionality. Built a state-driven animation engine using React hooks and modular architecture for integrating additional algorithms.

projects.name: Clinical Data Analysis Platform
projects.description: Full-stack clinical analytics platform enabling researchers to upload, analyze, and visualize medical datasets through a browser interface. Implemented statistical modules including Kaplan-Meier survival analysis, logistic regression, PCA, clustering, anomaly detection, and GPT-powered clinical insights generation.
